pack.topic: Avoiding FOMO Property Buying in Coimbatore Through Disciplined Evaluation
pack.source_script_insight: The source reel's core insight is that frantically rushing or stressing over outcomes is unnecessary because what is genuinely meant for you will find you when you maintain calm discipline. In Coimbatore property investing, this translates to resisting market FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out) and aggressive sales pressure, relying instead on systematic verification so the right asset naturally aligns with your investment goals.
pack.coimbatore_angle: In fast-expanding Coimbatore corridors like Saravanampatti, Trichy Road, and Kovaipudur, buyers are frequently bombarded with artificial urgency and 'act now before price hike' pitches. Instead of panic buying unverified plots or overpriced units, investors in Coimbatore must practice calm due diligence.
pack.visual_strategy: The physical evidence centers on human posture and document touchpoints: shifting from a stress-inducing smartphone screen packed with red promotional alert popups to calm, physical document review and quiet on-site measurement under Coimbatore daylight. The camera moves from tight, tense handheld angles on screens to steady, eye-level cinematic tracking shots of verified land boundaries.
pack.core_takeaway: Don't let FOMO force a hasty property purchase in Coimbatore; disciplined verification ensures the right investment comes to you.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
A. MANDATORY OUTPUT FORMAT LOCK
- Duration: EXACTLY 10.0 seconds.
- Aspect Ratio: Native Portrait 9:16 vertical video composition.
- Framing: Full vertical coverage, no horizontal bars, no black bands, no pillarboxing.

B. REALISM LOCK
- Style: Ultra-photorealistic real-world documentary footage captured on a 35mm cinema lens.
- Location: Authentic Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India settings (residential avenues, red soil plot borders, modern clean office interiors).
- Lighting & Texture: Natural warm South Indian sunlight, realistic sky exposure, soft lens flares, natural foliage movement, genuine tactile textures of paper, stone, glass, and wood. NO 3D renders, NO architectural CGI visualizers, NO cartoon animation, NO stock video look.

C. SOURCE SUBJECT LOCK
- Subject: Buyer Psychology (Overcoming FOMO and Panic Buying in Real Estate).
- Evidence Points Illustrated:
  1. Panic scrolling and artificial urgency cause poor investment choices.
  2. Turning away from digital noise allows disciplined verification.
  3. Hands-on physical verification (boundary checks, document review) ensures quality.
  4. The right asset aligns naturally when strict standards are maintained without frantic rushing.
- Local Setting: Coimbatore residential corridors.

D. SUBJECT-SPECIFIC VISUAL STRATEGY
- Opening Tension: Stressful smartphone scrolling with high-contrast alert notifications.
- Visual Transition: Rejection of phone -> Physical paper checklist -> Grounded site survey -> Calm walk -> Satisfactory deal completion.
- Forbidden Sequence: DO NOT show empty plot turning into 3D house, DO NOT show family hugging, DO NOT show generic construction workers.

E. CAMERA & IMAGE QUALITY
- Gear feel: Handheld tension in Scene 1, smooth steadycam stabilization in Scenes 2-7.
- Color Profile: Natural cinematic tone, realistic skin tones, rich greens of Coimbatore flora, warm sunset color palette in final frame.

F. EXACT 7-SHOT BREAKDOWN
- Shot 1 (0.0s - 1.4s):
  - Frame: Close-up macro 9:16.
  - Action: Finger rapidly scrolling on a modern smartphone screen displaying loud promotional property notifications with red text ('PRICE HIKE SOON'). Background shows slightly out-of-focus Coimbatore traffic street daylight.
  - Text Overlay: 'DON'T PANIC'
  - Tamil VO: 'பதற்றத்தில் அவசரப்பட்டு'

- Shot 2 (1.4s - 2.8s):
  - Frame: Eye-level medium shot.
  - Action: Investor hand resolutely turns off the smartphone screen and places it face-down onto a sleek teak wooden office desk.
  - Text Overlay: 'STOP FOMO'
  - Tamil VO: 'சொத்து வாங்காதீங்க.'

- Shot 3 (2.8s - 4.2s):
  - Frame: Top-down close-up.
  - Action: Hands opening a crisp white document folder labeled with legal verification checklists and land survey maps.
  - Text Overlay: 'VERIFY FIRST'
  - Tamil VO: 'FOMO பயத்தை விட்டுட்டு,'

- Shot 4 (4.2s - 5.6s):
  - Frame: Low-angle tracking shot.
  - Action: A yellow measuring tape extended tight against a granite boundary stone embedded in red soil, with coconut trees and faint Coimbatore hills under blue sky in background.
  - Text Overlay: 'CHECK FACTS'
  - Tamil VO: 'தெளிவான சரிபார்ப்பில்'

- Shot 5 (5.6s - 7.0s):
  - Frame: Eye-level forward-tracking shot.
  - Action: A well-dressed investor walking calmly along a wide paved avenue lined with leafy neem trees and clean residential plot fencing in Coimbatore.
  - Text Overlay: 'RIGHT ALIGNMENT'
  - Tamil VO: 'கவணம் வையுங்க.'

- Shot 6 (7.0s - 8.5s):
  - Frame: Medium close-up.
  - Action: Hands neatly closing a verified property deed binder, sunlight reflecting warmly off the leather cover.
  - Text Overlay: 'RIGHT ASSET'
  - Tamil VO: 'சரியான முதலீடு உங்களைத் தேடி வரும்.'

- Shot 7 (8.5s - 10.0s):
  - Frame: Wide cinematic landscape shot (composed vertically).
  - Action: Golden hour sunset illumination over a serene, fully-developed residential neighborhood layout in Coimbatore. Quiet atmospheric haze.
  - Text Overlay: 'OliveTree Investors'
  - Tamil VO: 'ஆலிவ்ட்ரீ இன்வெஸ்டர்ஸ்.'

G. MOTION-GRAPHICS LIMIT
- Only clean, minimalist sans-serif white text overlays positioned at lower third. No floating 3D icons, no glowing arrows, no cartoon callouts.

H. FINAL REAL SCENE
- Concludes on real golden-hour physical footage of a verified Coimbatore layout with minimal logo branding. No separate graphic end card.

I. NEGATIVE PROMPT / FIXED RULES
- Strict prohibition of: 3D render, animation, cartoon, graphic explainer, architectural visualizer, fake skyline, blurred sidebars, 16:9 padded video, fast whip pans, fisheye lens, duplicated people, generic happy family, construction site progress timelapse.
pack.title_english: Stop FOMO Property Buying in Coimbatore | OliveTree Investors
pack.caption_english: Frantic decisions often lead to costly real estate mistakes in high-growth cities like Coimbatore. When marketing hype creates artificial urgency, impulsive buyers rush into unverified deals out of fear of missing out. True investment success requires patience, strict legal due diligence, and clear location criteria. What is genuinely meant for your long-term wealth will align when you stick to systematic evaluation over emotional panic. Focus on verified titles, clear access, and calm analysis. Partner with OliveTree Investors for disciplined, stress-free property investments in Coimbatore.
